verdicts.reason: I couldn't find any visible difference between A and B, so they share the same flaws. In both, the skates are cut off at the left and right edges, and the 'ICE RINK' headline has shrunk so far that it no longer leads. The promo block is a jumbled stack: 'USE CODE', the stray divider lines, 'TO GET A DISCOUNT' and 'XMASRINK 50% OFF' have lost the original's two-column pairing. That small text is barely readable, the CTA is crammed into the lower middle, and a large empty band sits below it.
